description: DESPOT chooses the next action when the planner cannot see the true state, and it maximizes discounted reward. It samples K *scenarios*. Each is a start state from the particle belief and fixed random numbers for every step, so the tree holds only the observations that these scenarios produce. The search keeps an upper and a lower bound per node and explores where the gap is largest, while a cost λ per node (*regularization*) prefers small policies that do not overfit the scenarios. The crate follows the anytime algorithm of Ye et al. (2017) and recommends the action with the best lower bound; use it for large problems when POMCP's lack of bounds is a concern.

papers.authors: Adhiraj Somani, Nan Ye, David Hsu, Wee Sun Lee
papers.title: DESPOT: Online POMDP Planning with Regularization
